dedupe_keys.name: environment agency public register of waste operations permits england every permitted waste site with type operator grid reference and status

description: This register lists every environmental permit for a waste operation in England, from landfills and incinerators to transfer stations, treatment plants and mobile plant, so it serves as an inventory of the country's waste management facilities. It is kept by the Environment Agency under the Environmental Permitting Regulations. The complete register holds about 9,600 permits, each with permit and older licence numbers, holder and trading name, site name and type, address, postcode, grid reference with easting and northing, local authority, current status and the dates of issue, variation, transfer, surrender, revocation or suspension. Site pages carry permit documents and compliance assessment reports. The whole register is available as a free download (a zipped CSV) and through an API, under the Environment Agency Conditional Licence. Caveats: permitted capacity and tonnages are not in this table (they are reported through separate waste returns), site types use regulatory codes, and some permits cover several activities or mobile plant with no fixed site. Simulation uses: building the facility layer of waste collection and treatment network models, screening waste sites against flood and other hazard maps, and planning capacity when a facility closes. Related records: the Environment Agency historic landfill layer (data-ea-historic-landfill-sites) covers closed sites, and the England local authority waste statistics (data-defra-env18-local-authority-collected-waste) give the tonnages delivered.
